reviews.text:
The latest iteration of nike vomero appears to combine the comfort of invincible 3s (which they discontinued) with the support of the previous vomero shoes (which were a bit snug until broken in). For runners seeking both extreme comfort without forgoing support, the vomero 18s fit the bill perfects. The invincible 3s were so cushiony I nearly rolled my ankle several times but the ZoomX in the vomero 18s provides the right amount of "max" cushion (some people prefer less) to prevent the shoes from toppling to either side.

Personally, I wear a size 10 in Nikes but a 9.5 in almost everything else, so a Nike 10 fits me as well as most NIkes do. So, the shoes run small relative to most non-Nike shoes, but they fit as expected relative to "Nike" sizes. Do your feet a favor and try them for yourself!
reviews.title: the Cadillac of running shoes
